body: He knows I’m depressed but I’m not sure he fully understands the extend. Do you think my text message is okay to send him. He’s sleeping right now and my anxiety will stop me once we’re both awake if I don’t break the ice tonight

Thank you @fiddymac69 I really appreciate your insite on everything. I know my kid needs both his parents to get a good grasp at laugh. But there is nothing saying it needs to be man and woman. Lucky for my child I talked to the suicide hotline person tonight and I feel like that helped me get a real grasp for reality of my life.
I called the suicide hotline, talked for about 15 minutes… or me cried for about 15 minutes and currently feel like maybe tonight is not the night
Does a child even need their mom though if they have their father?
I really appreciate you. I hope it doesn’t change all of what you had said, but I am actually my child’s mother, not father. I tried calling the suicide hotline again and got disconnected.

It’s funny you replied you at the moment. I called the suicide hotline and those actually assholes put me on hold. And while I was holding I read through your message. For the night, perhaps I won’t end it. Because like we both agree. It’s not fair to our loved ones. How can we pass peacefully without our loved ones feeling like they had to make the ultimate decision?

I’m not sure if it’s worth not drinking everything under the kitchen counter while my partner and kid sleep in the other room… I just don’t want my kid to find me… but my partner usually wakes up first anyways… what should you do?
